item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Crystal Castles - Studio Albums (Qobuz FLAC)
item.description:
Hello everyone,
I hope you're all doing well.

I was wondering if anyone happens to have any of the following Crystal Castles albums from Qobuz in their original FLAC format:

  • Crystal Castles (2008)
    https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/crystal-castles-crystal-castles/0060270081222

  • Crystal Castles (II) (2010)
    https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/crystal-castles-ii-crystal-castles/bv5u9irk8vdgc

  • (III) (2012)
    https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/iii-crystal-castles/iy8czif49xn1a

  • Amnesty (I) (2016)
    https://www.qobuz.com/us-en/album/amnesty-i-crystal-castles/ujnt9ovyby0zb
If anyone happens to have all of them or even just one of these albums, I would really appreciate it if you could share the original Qobuz files.

Thank you very much in advance for your time and generosity. I truly appreciate all the help this community provides!
